title: Run members
summary: Supplemental proof credits when its recorded item-project commit contains the current landing; re-merging withdraws proof lacking the new landing. Final-target custody never blocks needed supplemental enrollment. A same-environment holder covers the same commit and selection, or an item owing no more QA there; failed proof enrolls again on a later run. Unreadable containment fails closed with its reason and recovery. Stage and Production may differ in surrounding code, fixes or reverts; Production-target obligations still guard Production and other items carry their own QA.
